overloads.semanticRole: Get the reference ID (MenuRef) of the current menu bar, or of the menu bar of a specified process, for use by other commands of the Menus theme.

constraints: The returned MenuRef ID may become invalid as soon as another menu bar is installed via SET MENU BAR; to keep a persistent reference to a menu created in the menu bar editor, copy it in memory first with Create menu.
If process is omitted, the command returns the ID of the menu bar of the current process.
